doc: Strands Agents' own name for the system prompt.

carriers.doc: The system prompt a model was given, reported beside the conversation: a detached request frame.

detect.doc: LAST, and the rank is the whole point: the SideSeat SDK defaults service.name to `strands-agents`, so this rule's service-name signal would otherwise claim every span of every framework using the SDK. The phrase search covers the three spellings a name may use and was a Rust matcher.
detect.label: StrandsAgents

messages.doc: The instruction the agent was given, read as a message. Ranked ahead of every conversation carrier because it frames the request rather than answering it - the retired code emitted it first for the same reason. Blank counts as absent: the attribute is written whether or not there is a prompt.

A choice event may carry a bundled tool result beside the model's reply, in the provider's own envelope. Reported as its own observation - and *added* to the event's raw form rather than replacing it, because the reply is wanted too. Tagged as a tool result rather than a tool message, so history filtering does not remove it; the bundle is split at query time, which is what keeps a fix applying to stored data.

attach.doc: The first identified call in the bundle, which identifies the message; the rest are recovered when it is split.
